Max Verstappen won the **2023 Formula 1 World Drivers’ Championship**, securing his third consecutive title (2021, 2022, 2023). He achieved this with a record-breaking 19 race victories in the 22-race season, driving for Red Bull Racing.

The **2024 Formula 1 season** is currently underway (as of June 2024), but the championship has not yet been decided—the season concludes in December 2024. Verstappen is the reigning and current points leader, but the 2024 title winner will only be confirmed later this year.
